title: Modalities in non-classical variations of $\mathsf{S4}$
summary: A classical result in modal logic states that $\mathsf{S4}$ has $14$ modalities, that is, every sequence of negations, boxes, and diamonds is equivalent to one in a set of $14$ such sequences. We study analogous results for the non-classical analogues $\mathsf{CS4}$, $\mathsf{IS4}$, $\mathsf{GS4}$, and $\mathsf{GS4^c}$ of $\mathsf{S4}$. First, we show that, while all these logics have finitely many $\{\Box,\Diamond\}$- and $\{\neg,\Box\}$-modalities, the logic $\mathsf{CS4}$ has infinitely many $\{\neg,\Diamond\}$-modalities.
